findingClass: an IPO whose listing the system already recorded (a listing_performance row) while ipos.status is not LISTED or ipos.listing_date is NULL -- readers see a listed company as closed and not listed (#70, #36, #72)
failThreshold: any listing_performance row whose ipos row has status <> LISTED or listing_date IS NULL; reported by slug with status and both dates
unverifiableWhen: never -- both tables exist on every slot
